attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 17 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2, and node3 (read-only standbys) on Alpine Linux. Set up wal_level=replica, a scram-sha-256 authenticated replicator role, and pg_basebackup-cloned standbys with standby.signal + primary_conninfo. Verified real-time write propagation and standby read-only enforcement. Completed mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes one at a time (standbys first, primary last, preserving quorum/connectivity throughout), proving changed boot_id and full recovery of replication and data on each. This notification was a stray background sleep task from earlier polling and required no further action.
